source_text: Nang hingan ng komento, sinabi na Miller na, "Parating nagsasalita si Mike sa panahon ng pagdinig...Naghahanda na ako kaya hindi ko gaanong narinig ang kanyang sinabi. "
english: When asked for comment, Miller said, "Mike is always talking during the hearing... I was getting ready so I didn't really hear what he said. "
